sources.finding: Official final gamebook records Cincinnati 31, Miami 24; 3,600 regulation seconds; both complete starter, substitute, DNP and inactive inventories; sole competitive quarterback duty by Joe Burrow and Malik Willis; all six kicking specialists; and every printed injury and return update.
Cincinnati confirms Kyle Dugger, Connor Lew, Myles Hinton, Jack Endries, Colbie Young and Landon Robinson inactive.
Miami confirms Caleb Douglas, Kaytron Allen, Reese Taylor, Robert Beal Jr., DJ Campbell, Chukwuebuka Godrick and Justin Joly inactive.

Official final report lists Cincinnati Kyle Dugger out and Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Colbie Young, Swayze Bozeman and Bryan Cook questionable; Miami Caleb Douglas, Justin Joly, Robert Beal Jr., Reese Taylor and Storm Duck out and Jaylen Wright, Kenneth Grant and Jackson Woodard questionable.
Cincinnati placed Andrei Iosivas on reserve/injured on September 26 because of the thumb injury he sustained in Week 2.
Cincinnati's initial 53-man announcement placed Brian Parker II and Ja'Sir Taylor on reserve/injured designated for return and included Iosivas and the three specialists on the initial roster.

Miami's initial roster announcement placed Darrell Baker Jr. and Storm Duck on reserve/PUP and Trey Moore and Kenneth Grant on reserve/injured designated for return; it also identifies the initial offensive, defensive and specialist rooms.
Miami activated Kenneth Grant from injured reserve on October 10 and elevated Rodney McGraw and Carlos Washington Jr. for the game; the gamebook records all three active substitutes.
Miami states De'Von Achane suffered a season-ending Week 3 injury and that Ollie Gordon II had run for 229 yards on 44 attempts in Achane's place, including 88 yards on 18 carries against Cincinnati.
Miami's postgame review names Juju Brents in the active corner group and identifies Ollie Gordon II as the lead producer after Achane's season-ending injury.

Miami's August 31 transaction notice states that the club claimed cornerback Reese Taylor and tight end Justin Joly off waivers from Denver, binding both Miami Week 5 identities to the exact Denver-tagged players in the frozen registry.
